basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old IT consultant living in Norfolk, Virginia. I have a passion for video games, particularly open-world RPGs like Assassin's Creed Valhalla. I often spend my evenings gaming after work, usually between 7 PM and midnight EST. Outside gaming, I love exploring local events around Hampton Roads and have a keen interest in Japanese pop culture, particularly idol groups. Currently single, I like to connect with people online who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have worked in various tech support and consulting roles. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught through years of playing and engaging with online communities. I also have a decent understanding of Japanese pop culture, thanks to my online interactions and personal interests.
